title: Technical Reference for Hayes Modem Users

fixity.scan_notes: Bitsavers archival scan; checksum/page inventory still to record.

redistribution_notes: Link to archival scan; do not mirror until rights status is established.

claims_extracted.claim: Hayes documentation identifies a Hayes Standard AT Command Set and documents a character-oriented command interface for modem control.
claims_extracted.notes: This 1993 reference documents the mature Hayes interface family, not its first introduction date.

claims_extracted.claim: Hayes modem configuration includes numbered S-registers whose meanings/defaults are part of the device control interface.
claims_extracted.notes: Register genealogy must be reconstructed model by model.

claims_extracted.claim: The Hayes interface distinguishes command control from online data operation and documents mechanisms for returning to command control.
claims_extracted.notes: Exact first-generation +++ guard-time semantics require earlier Smartmodem manuals.

notes: Primary vendor documentation for mature Hayes command semantics; pair with earlier manuals and independent software/configuration evidence for chronology and compatibility diffusion.
